prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a retail location. Insured vehicle and claimant vehicle both reported as stationary at time of impact, with minor contact to rear bumper area of claimant vehicle. Claimant reports neck stiffness and headache at the scene and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Claimant is not represented by counsel at this time.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant describes neck pain beginning later that evening and reports difficulty turning the head fully to the left. Claimant states they visited an urgent care clinic and was given a diagnosis of whiplash-type soft tissue injury. Requested copies of medical records and signed authorization forms. Claimant indicated willingness to provide them.

Entry 3: Reviewed photographs submitted by claimant and insured. Damage appears consistent with a low-impact rear contact, with scuffing and a small crack in the plastic bumper cover on the claimant vehicle. Repair estimate requested from preferred body shop. Recorded that no airbag deployment occurred in either vehicle.

Entry 4: Claimant called to ask about the injury claim process and whether they need an attorney. Explained that representation is optional and that the claimant may proceed directly with the adjuster. Provided a general overview of how medical documentation and wage loss information are reviewed. Claimant said they will think about it and will let us know.

Entry 5: Received medical records from the urgent care clinic. Records document cervical strain, prescribed muscle relaxants and a follow-up visit with a physical therapist. Claimant reports ongoing neck discomfort but says they are returning to normal daily activities. File flagged for continued medical review pending completion of physical therapy and receipt of repair estimate.
